create_flashinfer_backend: create a flashinfer attention backend for a model runner with optional MLA and EAGLE speculative decoding support
register_attention_backend: register a custom attention backend by name using the decorator to add it to the ATTENTION_BACKENDS registry
attn_backend_wrapper: wrap a full attention backend with a hybrid linear attention backend for models like hybrid GDN or Mamba2
create_flashattention_v3_backend: create a FlashAttention v3 backend with device capability checks for SM>=80 on NVIDIA or MP>=31 on Musa
create_flashmla_backend: create a FlashMLA backend for multi-latent attention models using the flashmla library
